children: The HR leader brings over 25 years of experience across technology services, telecommunications, banking and professional services

Artech has appointed Samriti Malhotra as Head – HR, India & APAC, bringing on board a human resources leader with more than 25 years of experience across technology services, telecommunications, banking, manufacturing and professional services.

In her new role, Malhotra will lead the company's human resources function across India and the Asia-Pacific region, focusing on talent strategy, organisational development, employee engagement and workforce transformation.

Prior to joining Artech, she served as Chief Human Resources Officer at UDS Group from January 2025 to September 2026. Before that, she spent more than 10 years at Denave, where she held the position of Vice President – Human Resources between October 2014 and January 2025, leading people-related initiatives and supporting organisational transformation.

Earlier, Malhotra was Country Lead – Human Resources at Environmental Resources Management (ERM), where she handled HR responsibilities for its India operations. She also worked as an HR Business Partner at Barclays between December 2010 and August 2012.
Her earlier career includes a seven-year association with Bharti Airtel as HR Manager, from December 2001 to January 2009, and an initial stint at Sterlite Industries as an Executive.

Across these assignments, she has developed experience in strategic HR business partnering, organisational design, talent management, diversity and inclusion, employee value proposition, employee engagement and change management. Her professional background also includes handling HR transformation initiatives and supporting organisational growth across diverse business environments.
Malhotra has completed the CHRO Leadership Programme at Cornell University and holds an MDBA in Human Resources from Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune.

Artech is a global talent, technology and delivery solutions provider with operations across 34 locations and a workforce of more than 11,500 professionals. The company works with enterprises across talent services, technology solutions and managed delivery.
